CommitIgnoresBaseVersion.because: commit stores the model without comparing base_version with the stored version, so a writer who prepared against an older version overwrites what another writer committed in between

CommitWithoutDigest.because: commit stores whatever model is sent without comparing it with the digest that propose returned, so the stored version is not the one the person saw and approved

CloneCopiesLatest.because: clone copies the newest version while recording that it came from the version that was asked for, so the copy's forked_from names a model it does not hold
